result:
Summary: The ManuRAG paper introduces a multi-modal QA system tailored to the manufacturing domain, designed to identify operational bottlenecks, improve product design, and support data-driven decision-making in complex manufacturing processes. ManuRAG extends traditional RAG systems by incorporating multimodality to process diverse data types from manufacturing documents, including text, images, formulas, and tables. The system employs a multi-modal large language model that accepts both plain text and images as inputs, enabling it to process PDF files through a pipeline of object detection and text recognition models. The paper also discusses related work on question answering systems and limitations of traditional RAG methods, suggesting directions for future work.
